0.msg: Actually, I saw some pieces of an old map near the tomb. They had words like 'ring' and 'key' written on them. Sadly, it didn't occur to me they might be important until just now. The Hectors must have them...

1.msg: So, I saw some pieces of an old map near the tomb where the ring was found. That's... pretty much everything I know about the ring.

2.msg: That map must be the key to the Book of Ancient's location.

4.msg: Alcaster in El Nath asked me to find the Book of Ancient for him.

5.msg: Hectors in the area must have the map pieces. Go find them and take them to Alcaster. Perhaps he can make sense out of this mess.

0.0: I knew I could count on you. I had the utmost faith in you. This will help me recover my health. Like I promised, here's the item that may hold key to finding #b#t4031056##k. Before that, though, check and make sure your etc. inventory is available for storage.

yes.0: You'd better find all 4 map pieces and take them to Alcaster. Also, I think your #b#t4031053##k holds more significance than you might think. So keep it safe.

no.0: Have you given up on finding the Book of Ancient?

npc.0: You'd better get all 4 map pieces from the Hectors and take them to Alcaster. Also, I think your #b#t4031053##k holds more significance than you might think. So keep it safe.

item.0: Did you find out where the #b#t4031056##k is? What happened? You look like you lost something. Maybe you should talk to the people you met earlier. They might know what happened.
